description:
Get a specific time-tracking entry for a project from Holded.

Args:
  - project_id (string): The project ID (required)
  - time_id (string): The time-tracking ID to retrieve (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Time-tracking details including duration, description, cost, and other fields.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_projects_get_project_time_tracking
title: Get Holded Project Time Tracking
